title: Zephyrine and the Clock
author: A. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Ulyana Galloway, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
